profile.headline: builder of things (usually backend infrastructure)
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer based in the California bay area with experience working with distributed systems, performance engineering, and disaster readiness/recovery. I have led org-wide efforts spanning numerous teams in order to improve the reliability of company infrastructure and have extensive experience working with customers to dive into the lowest level details and get things done.

Some of my achievements include expanding the usage of fault injection testing to most core infrastructure services at Meta including those dealing with sensitive PII (Personal identifiable Information) and financial data (requiring SOX compliance), as well as learning Rust and Linux eBPF in a single month to create a network dependency monitoring solution that enables engineers to discover new dependencies before a change makes it into production.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Reliability Infrastructure:
- Capacity Management: Working to ensure Meta's datacenter footprint is able to grow sustainably while minimizing reliability risks
- Disaster Recovery: Working to ensure Meta's products remain available even if 1+ physical data centers are lost

positions.description: Designed and integrated software components to better serve customers using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, NodeJS, Python, Flask, PIL, PostgreSQL, Ubuntu, and Amazon Linux. Refactored and optimized internal tools--reducing memory usage and running time by 95% in some cases.

projects.title: Eevee
projects.description: A web application that generates semi-legal unencrypted Pokémon data files. Data files are binary large objects built at the byte level. Built using browser-based JavaScript for BLOB generation and Node.js for serving data from MySQL via a public-facing API.

projects.title: Hog
projects.description: A basic multi-user messaging protocol implemented in Go. Utilizes TCP message framing for message delimiting and single byte opcodes to determine message validity and intent. Key features include join/leave message broadcasting as well as a working heartbeat implementation written using goroutines.
